collection.description: A villager plants three seeds upside down to see whether a seed knows which way is up.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has always wondered how a seed knows which way to grow. It's in the dark, underground. Nobody tells it where the sky is. So, as an experiment, (subject.he/she) plants three seeds the right way up and three seeds upside down, and marks each one with a little stick.

choices.label: Dig Them Up After a Few Days
Wait and See What Comes Up

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) waits. All six seeds come up, perfectly normal, pointing at the sky. (subject.He/She) can't tell which ones were upside down anymore. (friend) suggests that maybe the seeds just turned round when nobody was looking. (subject) thinks that's exactly what happened, and wishes (subject.he/she) had been looking.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (subject) carefully uncovers all six. Every one of them, even the upside-down ones, has sent its shoot curling round to point straight up, and its root straight down. (subject) sits back on (subject.his/her) heels, amazed. The seeds know. (subject.He/She) has no idea how. That's somehow even better.
